name: kb_subtlety_rogue
notes: The Turtle knowledge base's Subtlety list: Hemorrhage as the only builder, Expose Armor at five points while it is missing, Slice and Dice at low points and Rupture at five (Taste for Blood), Eviscerate as the spare finisher, Mark for Death at two points into Shadow of Death at five. Garrote opens from stealth, which is outside the brain's fight; Tricks of the Trade needs a party target, Blade Flurry is the KB's no, Preparation's 'after the first Mark', the burst call and Vanish are named in kb.unexpressed.
sources: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150991#p150991 (Shananagans, player (guide writer, self-declared no Subtlety experience), 2025-09-09)

priorities.note: The swing is the base every entry waits on: it goes first in the order, as in the Go rotation (rogue_combat).
no_self_aura, not self_aura_missing: the buff lasts under a minute (6 s per combo point), so the under-a-minute rule would spend every combo point on it.
